moments.title: Be still
moments.reflection: Let the noise of the day settle. You do not need to have everything resolved before you pause in God’s presence.

photo.alt: St Michael and All Angels in Mickleham, with its spire, blue clock and red door.

moments.title: Come and rest
moments.reflection: Bring the weariness you are carrying, without needing to explain it away. Let this be a moment to rest in Christ’s welcome.

photo.alt: Sunlight and trees among the headstones beside St Michael’s Church.

moments.title: Quiet trust
moments.reflection: Take a slow breath and make room for a little quiet. You may offer God one simple prayer for what you need today.

photo.alt: Lavender beside a bench in the parish garden of remembrance.

moments.title: Lift your eyes
moments.reflection: Notice the light and the beauty around you. Allow a small word of gratitude, or a question, to become your prayer.

photo.alt: Harvest flowers beneath a stained-glass window inside the church.

moments.title: Peace for today
moments.reflection: Whatever waits beyond this moment, pause before you return to it. Ask Christ for peace to carry into the next small step.

photo.alt: Open red doors and Harvest flowers in the church entrance porch.
